name: Bitquery
tagline: GraphQL and streaming on-chain data across many blockchains
description: Bitquery provides GraphQL and streaming APIs for blockchain data across many chains, with strong coverage of DEX trades, transfers, balances, and analytics. Developers query historical and real-time on-chain activity via a unified GraphQL endpoint and related streaming products.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY (or X-API-KEY); self-serve signup at account.bitquery.io

pricing.free_tier_limits: 7-day no-card trial: 1,000 API points, 100 MCP credits, 2 simultaneous streams, 17 stream-minutes, and 0.2 GB stream bandwidth; trial sandbox includes all chains and complete history.

rate_limits: Personal: 30 requests/minute and 3 concurrent requests; Pro: 90/min and 6 concurrent; Scale: 240/min and 12 concurrent; Enterprise: custom.

example.request: curl -X POST 'https://graphql.bitquery.io' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY' -d '{"query":"{ EVM(network: eth) { Blocks(limit: {count: 1}) { Block { Number } } } }"}'

use_cases: query recent DEX trades on Ethereum or Solana
get token transfer history for a wallet
fetch token balances and prices across chains
